name: Gluten Free Scones
yields: Eight 3–4-inch triangle scones, or about ten 3½–4-inch drop scones
notes: Variation: Replace cranberries with dried currants. Or make lemon blueberry ones (sub blueberries for cranberries and lemon zest for orange zest).

items: 2⅓ cups (327 g) Pamela’s Baking & Pancake Mix
¼ cup (4 tablespoons) butter, cut in small dice, chilled

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.body: Preheat oven to 375°F. Lightly grease a baking sheet or line it with parchment paper.

steps.title: Whisk the dry ingredients
steps.body: Whisk together **2⅓ cups (327 g) Pamela’s Baking & Pancake Mix**, **⅓ cup + 1 tablespoon sugar** and **1 teaspoon baking powder**.

steps.title: Cut in the butter
steps.body: Cut **¼ cup (4 tablespoons) butter** into dry ingredients, using two knives, pastry blender, or electric stand mixer with paddle attachment, until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.body: Add **⅓ cup milk**, **1 egg**, large, beaten, **½ cup dried cranberries** and **1 tablespoon finely chopped orange zest** (optional), and mix until just combined. Dough will be thick.

steps.title: Shape triangle scones
steps.body: To make triangle scones: Turn dough out onto a baking sheet and pat it into a 6- to 8-inch circle, about 1½-inch thick. Cut the circle into quarters, then cut those quarters in half, to make 8 triangle-shaped pieces. Separate the pieces about an inch apart before baking.

steps.title: Or shape drop scones
steps.body: To make drop scones: Scoop or drop about ¼ cup of dough per scone onto baking sheet and pat into balls.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake for 14–17 minutes until just starting to brown on the edges.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.body: Make lemon or orange glaze to go on top!
